scope: decision register round 4: agent visibility/revocation, archive audit trimming, monotonic clock, documented decisions

A1_agent_review.change: schema 17 agent_links records every registered agent identity; registration posts a low-importance notification with package + signer prefix; settings lists connected agents with a revoke action that drops sessions and broker grants; at most 4 sessions per UID
A1_agent_review.not_done: no explicit consent dialog before registration, because it would break the current SDK call sequence

B1_archive_caps.change: an audit trail that would exceed the 20k record cap exports only the newest rows that fit, marks the archive auditTrimmed, and tells the user in the export confirmation that older events stay on the device; verification starts from the first included row's prevHash
B1_archive_caps.not_done: no chain compaction (that would rewrite history)

C1_monotonic_clock.change: nextLocalClock() keeps the largest issued timestamp in prefs and returns max(now, last+1), so a wall-clock correction cannot produce an older edit; the {actor: timestamp} encoding and merge logic are unchanged

C3_C1_D1_D2_docs.sync_model: README (both languages) states the single-writer assumption and that cross-device sync is unverified
C3_C1_D1_D2_docs.signing: docs/production_signing_decision.md section 8 records the decision to stay on development-key side loads with no store distribution, and the migration path if that changes
C3_C1_D1_D2_docs.downgrade: README install steps and the release process state that the schema only moves forward

verification.device_migration: schema 16 -> 17 applied on the Pixel 6a; the audit page stays green and a memory detail opens with 2 history versions
